name: Tokita Shuya
source:
"Lord? ...Hmm. The sound of that isn't bad. It's a good fit."
He's beautiful as long as he keeps his mouth shut, but when he opens it he speaks in an old fashioned way of speaking that is way above unusual.
A 5th grade elementary school student. He's a famous child model.
